message.subject: Re: Egocentric stereo data - pricing
message.body:
Hi,

As discussed, please find our quote below:

- Stereo egocentric video, indoor and urban scenes: USD 1,800 per hour of footage
- Minimum order: 200 hours
- Non-exclusive licence, delivery via S3 bucket
- Annotation (segmentation) optional at USD 350 per hour

This quote is valid for 30 days. Happy to walk you through it.

Best,
Maria
